name: Lee (Mirabai) Harrington
reason: Her work is mainly Tibetan medical healing sold on conditions: the Kripalu Nejang programme promises help with anxiety, depression, PTSD and recovery from illness, her healing-sessions and private-session pages list conditions, and most of her YouTube uploads are mantra music or carry healing claims (heart ailments, bone fractures, viruses, 'heals all disease'); what remains is two or three short clips and a memoir about her dog, too thin for a page.
